operations.title: String readout commutator descent is positive at five points and untyped globally at six points

Six-point exceptional modules are cyclic/dihedral covariant, but no global source-amplitude pairing has yet been constructed, so physical-readout commutator descent remains untyped there.

operations.title: Six-point string physical-pairing commutator test
operations.summary: Construct the source-normalized pairing of the rank-eight exceptional shift module with the global source cycle and test dihedral commutator generators on the pairing, transporting both variances.
